Verified trueandco.com (True&Co), San Francisco online bra-fit quiz and lingerie retailer founded 2012 by Michelle Lam. $2M seed in May 2012 (First Round, SoftTech VC, SoftBank Capital, Aileen Lee) and $4M more in Oct 2013 (Crosslink, VegasTechFund, Pejman Nozad, FundersClub plus existing investors). TechCrunch doesn't name the 2013 round; trackers call it Series A. Disclosed rounds total $6M, but TechCrunch (2017) says it raised a reported $13M in total, so later rounds went undisclosed. PVH (Calvin Klein's owner) acquired it in March 2017 for an undisclosed price, reportedly in the tens of millions, with investors mostly getting their money back.
